shots.focal_element: Tilted close-up of an illustrated character's round face (orange sweater) with work icons (envelope, pie chart, hourglass, arrows, papers) orbiting around it
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right brand wordmark: lowercase, bold geometric sans, tight tracking, preceded by a short underscore-like bar; no other text.
shots.what_happens: Over the opening line 'If only you could conjure some magic' (w0-w6) the stressed character's face cycles expressions (smile, grimace with tongue out, sweat drop, wince) while flat office icons (envelopes, pie charts, hourglass, arrows, documents) fly and rotate around the head, conveying overwhelm by manual tasks.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a full-bleed flat outlined SVG character head on a solid background, swap face-feature groups on a ~0.5s cadence, and animate 5-6 icon sprites along looping rotate+translate paths around the head with a fixed corner wordmark overlay.

shots.focal_element: Isometric-ish illustrated open-plan office full of characters flailing arms up, with laptops, envelopes, pie charts and calendars flying
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a busy office where every worker throws arms up as documents, envelopes, pie charts and a calendar bounce between desks, illustrating chaotic manual work under 'to turn manual tasks into' (w7-w11). The last sampled frame (4.5s) already shows the building exterior, so the cut may fall slightly before the anchor boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Compose a static flat office background layer and loop simple arm-raise cycles on each character while icon sprites follow short parabolic hops between desks, all in one full-bleed frame.

shots.focal_element: Extreme close-up of a striped office building facade (orange, cream and purple panels) with a green tree silhouette in the foreground
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Two-frame (0.083s) step of a fast pull-out from the building facade; foreground tree and background sky layers separate, part of a stepped zoom-out sequence (s003-s005) under 'smooth' (w12).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a tightly cropped frame of the building facade layer (scale ~2x) with a foreground tree layer for 2 frames as the first step of a stepped camera pull-out.

shots.focal_element: The same striped building, slightly wider, now with clouds and neighbouring buildings visible, tree silhouette in front
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Second two-frame step of the pull-out: the camera is wider, revealing clouds and adjacent buildings; the cut reads as a staccato zoom rather than a scene change.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the same layered city scene at a smaller scale (~1.5x) for 2 frames, offsetting the foreground tree less than the building to fake parallax.

shots.focal_element: The building now revealed as a round cylindrical tower with a flat purple roof, centred in a stylised city skyline
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Final two-frame step of the pull-out: the facade resolves into a cylindrical tower seen with its roof, centred among skyline shapes and clouds, landing on 'smooth systems' (w12-w13).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the city scene near final scale (~1.15x) with the tower centred for 2 frames before the settled wide shot.

shots.focal_element: The cylindrical tower in the city skyline and an on/off toggle switch that forms in the sky above it
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Wide settled skyline: the sun becomes a ring, then stretches into a pill-shaped toggle whose orange knob switches on during 'automatically' (w14); the tower's window stripes re-colour in a sweep, and the knob leaves the toggle and drops onto the tower roof (around 7.0-7.5s). The 8.0s sampled frame already shows the office, so the next cut may come slightly before the anchor boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Morph a circle sun into a rounded-rect toggle (scaleX + border-radius), slide its knob across with an ease-out, then tween the knob along an arc onto the tower roof while staggering a colour swap on the tower's vertical panels.

shots.focal_element: Large orange circle (the toggle knob) bouncing through the busy illustrated office
shots.typography: Only the persistent top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' wordmark.
shots.what_happens: Back in the office, the orange knob from the toggle drops in and bounces across the desks, squashing and growing as it passes through the chaos while workers keep flailing; no voice-over in this shot, carried by music and chime-like SFX (x002-x004). The 9.5s sampled frame shows a centred character with arms up on a plain background, likely the start of the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Over the existing office loop, animate an orange circle along a bouncing path with squash-and-stretch scale keys timed to the music hits, scaling it up as it nears camera.
